title: Do this later turns the setting on without flagging anyone
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a new organization in which the Internal Work Orders setting has never been switched on.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings > Work Orders.
  2. Switch the "Internal Work Orders" toggle on.
  3. Click "Do this later".
  4. Reload the page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The toggle is off.

Step 2:

  • The "Which customers are your own company?" window opens.

Step 3:

  • The window closes and the toggle shows on.
  • Under the description the first hint reads "No internal customer yet. Work orders for your own equipment stay billable until you flag one: Edit Customer > Internal customer. No Charge on customer work orders works now."

Step 4:

  • The toggle is still on after the reload, so it was saved.
  • The same "No internal customer yet" hint shows.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11758 (Story 1, Turn on Internal Work Orders, flag internal customers, manage categories)

  • S1-R5: “"Do this later" saves the toggle (on) and closes the modal without flagging anyone; the hint of S1-R4 shows under the toggle until a customer is flagged, as the reminder of what is left to do. No Charge (Story 2) works with no flagged customer. There is no step the user must complete.”
  • S1-R4: “While the toggle is on and no customer carries the flag, the first hint of S1-R3 reads instead "No internal customer yet. Work orders for your own equipment stay billable until you flag one: Edit Customer > Internal customer. No Charge on customer work orders works now." The text is informational; nothing is required and nothing is blocked.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Setting on, no customer flagged | "No internal customer yet. Work orders for your own equipment stay billable until you flag one: Edit Customer > Internal customer.
